title: Common Network Attacks: The Complete Beginner's Guide

scenes.narration: Meet the digital break in crew. Each member has a different trick. Learn each one by name.

scenes.heading: The break-in crew
scenes.narration: Four tricks come up all the time. A denial of service attack floods a target so nobody can reach it. A S Y N flood starts handshakes and never finishes them. D N S amplification uses open resolvers to magnify a flood. A R P spoofing lies about who owns an address.

scenes.heading: Common mix-ups
scenes.narration: Quick matches. D D o S uses many sources. S Y N floods abuse the T C P handshake. A R P spoofing stays on the local subnet.

scenes.heading: Remember this
scenes.cta: Try the Courseiva network attacks lab
scenes.narration: So, to recap. D o S attacks hit availability. S Y N cookies help against S Y N floods. D A I stops A R P spoofing. Ready to practise? Try the Courseiva network attacks lab.
